title: Context transition filters every column of the iterated table: removing the key's filter leaves the others
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( Keyed, "T", CALCULATE ( SUM ( Keyed[Value] ), ALL ( Keyed[Id] ) ) )

source.quote: As a result, the calculated column computes the sum of Unit Price for all the products with the same color and unit price
source.supports: the article's CALCULATE ( SUM ( Product[Unit Price] ), ALL ( Product[ProductKey] ) ) sums the rows that share the other columns' values

source.quote: The CALCULATE modifiers are applied after the context transition, so they can alter the effects of the context transition.
source.supports: ALL is applied after the context transition and removes the filter it put on Id

derivation: The transition filters Id, Name and Value. ALL ( Keyed[Id] ) then removes the filter on Id only. The remaining filters Name and Value match: for ids 1 and 2 (A, 10) two rows, 10 + 10 = 20; for id 3 (B, 5) one row, 5; for ids 4, 5, 6 (C, 1) three rows, 1 + 1 + 1 = 3.
